weka_stats_client.note: no Mode==client rows — the client filter matched nothing; the filesystem-side number for this cell is MISSING, not zero

lustre_stats_client.note: osc read/write bytes summed across OSTs — every byte this client moved to storage (post-page-cache, counts aio; the quotable filesystem-side series for this cell); *_calls_per_sec are RPC rates

lustre_llite.note: llite (client VFS-level) rates — DIAGNOSTIC: blind to libaio traffic (proven 2026-08-21); llite-vs-osc shortfall is client-cache + aio-path evidence, never the cell's rate

lustre_osc.note: per-OST RPC-layer rates; the per-target spread is the striping evidence (D12)

lnet.note: per-net LNet message rates — the per-cell transport proof (D16)

netdev_counters.note: kernel netdev counters; Primary/Diagnostic split is per-leg (docs/RUNBOOK.md)

rdma_counters.note: RDMA/EFA device counters; header-only where no such device exists

nvidia_fs_stats.note: verbatim 1 Hz capture; parsed with D-6
